title: Low-Roof Mineral Vein Face Bay
description: One static low-roof mineral-face bay scene, one scene and zero new independent models. One whole original continuous-vein rock wall forms the rear face; two complete fixed screw roof props stand on tiny scene-only plinths beneath a broad flat scene-only roof, and one complete blunt double-point pick lies on the front floor apron. All original meshes, fixed poses, unit scale, source GLB payloads and opaque PBR remain unchanged under translation only. Four scene-only closed solids add the floor, roof and two plinths. This is an open-sided cutaway, not the previous open screening siding or tall shaft/headframe/rail bay. The original irregular wall top is retained, reaching the roof underside only at its highest station; no entire wall-top contact is claimed. No ore extraction, real roof support, structural load, human clearance, navigation, working machinery, ventilation or underground safety is demonstrated.
